# Move changes

??? quote "From Drayano's documentation"

    This document covers any changes made to any attacks. Only modified attacks are listed here, with modifications to power, type, accuracy, PP, or effects written out if applicable.

    The changes here mostly focus on making HM moves usable, as well as boosting the base power of some moves that feel too weak early or buffing the effectiveness of some moves obtainable by only a few Pokémon.
